3.text: the Reindeer people of the Kolyma I saw several times small wooden images

4.text: of canoes fastened to the charm-strings. This is the more remarkable, as

5.text: those people do not build canoes, and rarely buy them from the Russians,

6.text: as they have but little opportunity to use them. The canoe-image of the

7.text: charm-strings thus adds new proof to the conjecture that the maritime mode

8.text: of life predominated in ancient times with the whole Chukchee tribe.

15.text: chief masters of the herd, and are often more or less confounded with the

17.text: sent more or less directly the ancestors of the family. As such they are

18.text: called in common conversation “the ancient ones,” or even “the deceased ones.”
